consumerKinds.consumerKeyMeaning: narrative_extraction_runs.id -- the Run whose Proposals and Artifacts the declared Sources were read for.
consumerKinds.notes: Still declared for legitimate Run-owned Sources outside the legacy Backfill writer. C2-ZB's legacy_backfill.rs emits Application-grained Edges instead, each carrying its fresh Backfill Run in narrative_dependency_edges.owning_run_id.

consumerKinds.consumerKeyMeaning: narrative_proposal_revisions.id -- one immutable Revision of one Proposal.
consumerKinds.notes: Declared by repository.rs's record_revision_dependency_edges_in_tx: insert_proposal_seed and append_revision_on_conn key every Edge a Revision's Reconciliation Envelope declares under the Revision itself. This is the grain C2-2 exists to reach -- editing one Scene stales the Revisions that actually read it rather than every Proposal from the same Run. The Revision row is immutable once written and already carries the same Source Basis in narrative_revision_source_basis, so nothing had to be invented to key an Edge to it; the owning Run is kept separately as narrative_dependency_edges.owning_run_id.

consumerKinds.consumerKeyMeaning: narrative_extraction_artifacts.id -- one stored Interpreter output artifact.
consumerKinds.notes: The row is durable and immutable once written, but it carries no Dependency Manifest of its own today; narrative-run-kind-policy.json's artifact-with-explicit-dependency-manifest repair category is written against that future manifest. No Producer declares Edges under this kind yet.

consumerKinds.consumerKeyMeaning: narrative_proposal_applications.id -- one applied Projection of one Proposal Revision.
consumerKinds.notes: This is the identity legacy narrative_projection_freshness is already keyed by (application_id PRIMARY KEY). C2-ZB's legacy Backfill Producer declares Edges under this kind using application_id; every such Edge must carry an existing same-project owning Run. After the C2-ZC marker, canonical Freshness reads use the Generic Consumer row only; this Legacy identity remains compatibility data for parity and diagnostics.

consumerKinds.consumerKeyMeaning: narrative_application_contributions.id -- one field-level contribution of one Application to one target field.
consumerKinds.notes: The smallest durable unit that exists today: commit.rs already records one row per (application, target_object_identity, field_path) at apply time. Field-level Freshness is what lets one edited Scene stale one field rather than a whole Application. No Producer declares Edges under this kind yet.

The only Projection this codebase recomputes rather than applies directly: the row already stores constraint_set_digest, solver_version, and calendar_digest, which are Dependencies in everything but name. The directly applied Projection kinds (Codex Entry, Chronicle Event, Plot Marker, Foreshadow Setup/Payoff) are covered by application/application-contribution, not by this kind. No Producer declares Edges under this kind yet.

consumerKinds.consumerKeyMeaning: narrative_semantic_index_metadata.index_key -- one index a project builds (for example a lexical index and an embedding index are two Consumers).
consumerKinds.notes: The table's primary key is (project_id, index_key); only index_key belongs in the Consumer key, because narrative_consumer_freshness already carries project_id as its own column and a Consumer key must never repeat the project scope. semantic-core-authorities.json keeps semantic-index reserved with no Narrative dependency authority claim. While reserved, no semantic-index Generic Freshness/metadata rows are permitted; any non-zero footprint is manual-terminal evidence and never a Rebuild-Derived target. Only existing Scene/Codex/Event/Chat embedding chunk rows are rebuildable acceleration, and they cannot imply Narrative dependency authority. No Producer declares Edges under this kind yet.

consumerKinds.consumerKeyMeaning: One Narrative IR Revision, if it ever becomes a row.
consumerKinds.notes: No durable table exists. Interpreter output lives inside narrative_proposal_revisions.payload_json / reconciliation_envelope_json and narrative_extraction_artifacts.payload_json, never as its own addressable row, so there is nothing stable to key an Edge to. It cannot be a Consumer until it has one; deriving a key from payload content would be exactly the heuristic identity the C2-2 exit criteria forbid.

consumerKinds.consumerKeyMeaning: One materialized Related Scenes candidate set, if it ever becomes a row.
consumerKinds.notes: No durable table exists. src/features/related-scenes computes candidates per query and keeps nothing, so there is no materialization to stale. It becomes a Consumer only once a candidate set is persisted with its own identity.

consumerKinds.consumerKeyMeaning: One materialized Chat Context assembly, if it ever becomes a row.
consumerKinds.notes: No durable table exists. src/features/ai-context assembles context per request; the chat_* tables store the conversation, not the assembled context or the Sources it was assembled from. It becomes a Consumer only once an assembly is persisted with its own identity.

consumerKinds.consumerKeyMeaning: One persisted Consistency / Structure Health diagnostic, if it ever becomes a row.
consumerKinds.notes: No durable table exists. StructureHealthPanel.tsx is still a Gate C0 placeholder with liveCountsAvailable: false, and narrative_maintenance_finding_observations is a rebuildable observation history keyed by finding_key, not a durable diagnostic artifact that could itself be a Consumer.

unknownConsumerKindEnforcement.gap: Reported, not refused. consumer_identity::ConsumerKind::try_from fails closed on any kind outside this registry, and verify_narrative_dependency_graph_for_project lists such Edges under edge_ids_with_unresolvable_consumer_scope -- deliberately not under edge_ids_with_missing_source, whose Sources are present. The typed writer record_dependency_edge_in_tx enforces keyFormat's shape rules only, not membership, so an Edge under a reserved kind can still be stored; that is intentional while the reserved kinds have no readers, and it is what a Verify names rather than prevents. narrative_dependency_edges.consumer_kind and narrative_consumer_freshness.consumer_kind still carry only a length > 0 CHECK at the SQL layer.

keyFormat.note: publish_runtime.rs's and inbox_read_model.rs's consumer_finding_key both build this string, and the Maintenance Inbox and the Attention store both look Findings up by it, so the pair must round-trip. consumerKind carries no colon precisely so the first colon is the unambiguous separator; consumerKey may carry colons because a durable identity can be a compound key (a semantic-index index_key, a future namespaced id). emptyComponentPolicy and surroundingWhitespacePolicy apply to consumerKind and consumerKey alike: an empty or whitespace-padded component would make two different Consumers collide on one finding_key.

freshnessAuthority.note: Matches semantic-core-authorities.json's evidence-freshness row (canonicalAuthority: the C2 consumer freshness evaluator, compatibilityMirror: legacy projection freshness, writePolicy: canonical-only) and narrative-finding-contract.json's currentFreshnessLookup. narrative_projection_freshness is keyed by application_id alone and cannot express any other Consumer kind; before the C2-Z marker it is the compatibility read path, while after the marker it is never consulted by canonical reads. It is the mirror, not a second authority, and no third Freshness store may be created.

dependencySetDigest.computedOver: the set of narrative_dependency_edges.source_object_identity values declared under the Consumer's (project_id, consumer_kind, consumer_key)
dependencySetDigest.note: The digest is over the Consumer's whole Dependency set, so adding or removing one Edge changes it even when every surviving Edge's own state is unchanged -- that is what lets Verify tell 'evaluated against a different dependency set' apart from 'evaluated against the same set and still fresh'. The column is nullable and NULL for every row written before SCHEMA 24 added it; a NULL means this Consumer has not been evaluated since, and Verify must report it as not-yet-evaluated rather than as a graph inconsistency.

negativeFixture: a finding_key must never be split on its last colon: 'semantic-index:embeddings:v2' parses to consumerKind 'semantic-index' and consumerKey 'embeddings:v2', while last-colon parsing would silently mint the unregistered consumer kind 'semantic-index:embeddings'
